verdict.rationale: Clerky's remote MCP server is live and OAuth-gated. An AI assistant only gets the team access the user authorizes, and the tools are reportedly read-only, so agent credentials are scoped to some degree. However, the Partner API's OAuth scopes, token lifetime and client registration are explicitly 'coming soon' and unpublished. missing for 10: published, user-selectable permission scopes, documented token lifetime/revocation controls, a launched Partner API OAuth with scopes, and independent corroboration of the least-privilege behavior.
